summary: Eight of the ten are the big rich countries anyone types first, so a casual player finds 9: too easy for Today's list. As a Blitz it is excellent, since nearly every country a player can name scores.
reasons: Casual found 9 (all but the Philippines) and ran out on Mexico (#19), Russia (850, all closed in 2022), India (#12), Italy (#11) and Spain (#13); every miss shows its count, so the misses teach something.
Blitz: 31 of 32 casual names scored; only Russia scored nothing. One clean source (McDonald's own counts, December 31, 2025), all ten facts present.
Common forms work (america, england, holland, korea, phillipines), and the subject words (mcdonalds, burger, restaurants, united, south) hand over nothing.
